items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Austin Cromer sings your arrangement of If You Could See Me Now.

ctx.x: We’re going to change the format here a little bit, Melba, and do – let’s hear some music, some of your arrangements, and we’re going to comment on it. First thing I want to hear, Austin Cromer sings your arrangement of If You Could See Me Now. That was great. [The music plays.] How did you write that arrangement, Melba? Oh man, and sit through them playing it like that? Isn’t that a thrill? Do you get thrilled when you hear your arrangements?
